android.desc: OnePlayer is the ultimate offline video and music player for Android— no internet needed. Watch 4K/HD video, enjoy local audio with a powerful equalizer, or stream via URL, all in one lightweight app that won't drain your battery. ✨ All Format Support – MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, FLV, WMV, WEBM, FLAC, MP3, AAC, OGG, H.265 (HEVC) and more ✨ MP3 (ID3) Tag Editor – Edit title, artist, album, and artwork for your music files ✨ Background Playback – Keep video/audio playing while using other apps ✨ Powerful Equalizer – Enhanced audio for high-quality music playback ✨ Smart Gestures – Swipe to adjust volume, brightness, playback progress ✨ URL Playing – Stream any video by entering a web URL ✨ Controller Lock – Prevent accidental touches during long sessions ✨ Auto-Bookmark & Resume – Picks up exactly where you left off ✨ Night Mode – Auto, light, and dark themes ✨ Lightweight & Efficient – Under 5MB, battery-friendly for long sessions Supported Media Formats 1. Video: H.264 AVC, H.265 HEVC, MPEG-4, VP8, VP9, AV1 (Plays 4K, Ultra-HD, and Full HD seamlessly). 2. Audio: FLAC, MP3, OPUS, WAV, AAC, AC-3, TrueHD. 3. Subtitles: SRT, SSA, ASS, TTML, VTT. We're actively developing OnePlayer — your feedback shapes what we build next. 📧 Email: googolapps.support@gmail.com 💬 https://t.me/audiofy_support

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built OnePlayer: A lightweight, Material 3 offline player

quotes.text:
Hey everyone!

I wanted a music and video player that felt native to modern Android, so I built OnePlayer. It’s designed to be lightweight, fully offline, and highly customizable.

Key Features:

1. Material 3: Full dynamic color support (Android 12+).

2.  Customizable: Change layouts and UI configurations to fit your style.

3.  Audio Power: Built-in Equalizer and background playback.
4.  Gesture Control: Intuitive touch gestures for volume, brightness, and seeking.

5.  Smooth UI: Focused on fluid animations and an "intuitive" feel.

Note on FOSS: It is currently closed source while I stabilize the build, but I am planning to release a FOSS (Free and Open Source) version alongside a Pro version soon! I’m not a native English speaker, so I used some AI help to polish this post. I’d love to hear your thoughts on the UI or any bugs you find!

Download - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.googol.android.apps.oneplayer
